deliverable: A5 — Doc Canonical-Owner Registry (Phase 3, Workflow A EVIDENCE)
author: A5 doc+decision reconciliation subagent (read-only)
mode: READ-ONLY. Flags below are FINDINGS; no doc was moved/edited/tombstoned. Prefer a DETERMINISTIC registry + link-validation over a new knowledge DB (owner directive).
purpose: Flag duplicate / competing / stale / broken-canonical harness docs so the full truth stops being scattered across many partly-correct files and so new plans UPDATE the canonical owner instead of being rewritten fresh. Fields per owner spec: document_id, status, owner, canonical_for, valid_as_of, supersedes, superseded_by, implemented_in, last_verified.

status_legend.canonical-active: the current single owner for its subject; keep + update in place
status_legend.competing: two+ files claim the same canonical role — MUST collapse to one
status_legend.duplicate: byte/tree copy of a canonical source — retire/regenerate read-only
status_legend.stale: contradicted-by-current-truth or lacks supersede markers — tombstone/banner
status_legend.superseded: fully replaced by a newer doc (has/needs SUPERSEDED-BY pointer)
status_legend.still-open-prior-art: active planning content not yet implemented; preserve-by-reference
status_legend.broken-canonical: claims a canonical/gate role but its backing artifact is missing/mis-scoped
status_legend.phantom: referenced by name but NOT FOUND on disk

last_verified_method: Get-ChildItem mtime/size + git log/PR + ConvertFrom-Json + Grep + basic-memory recent_activity, this session 2026-07-13
